reason: The reviewer was not clearly told before the v6-v11 reviews that class_direct helmet means a worn helmeted-head region, while an unworn isolated hard hat is a negative. The original review evidence is preserved, but its pass/fail interpretation is not valid for opening the generation gate.

canonical_protocol.positive: one box per visible person wearing a safety hard hat; include the hard hat plus the wearer's head or part of the face
canonical_protocol.negative: unworn or isolated hard hat, logo, background, ordinary face, bare head, and other helmet-like objects
canonical_protocol.uncertain_policy: quarantine and replace in a preregistered order; do not count as pass or model failure

confirmed_impact_example.old_interpretation: the dataset GT and model both missed a loose hard hat
confirmed_impact_example.correct_interpretation: the loose unworn hard hat is a negative and should have neither a green nor a magenta helmeted-head box

downstream_effect.v7_to_v11_adaptations: retained as exploratory diagnostics because they used potentially contaminated owner feedback

required_recovery: Retrospectively triage revealed v6-v11 cases under the canonical protocol for diagnosis only.
Freeze a new Train-only candidate pool and deterministic replacement order before model outputs are revealed.
Perform GT-only adjudication first and quarantine dataset defects or uncertain cases.
Freeze the valid audit set, then run the model and perform a separate model-only review.
Open generation only after numeric gates pass and the corrected model review has zero confirmed model problems.
